# Pin

> Pin is a small statically typed language with PHP 8 syntax, compiled to native code through LLVM, with
> compile-time ownership instead of a garbage collector. It is meant to be written by AI coding agents.
> Version 0.7 (preview, not for production). Not everything from PHP exists: read the AI guide before writing Pin.

Has: functions; go/await tasks, a Hub for messages between requests, Server-Sent Events, an http://
client and run(); throws/try/catch errors; classes (no inheritance) with methods and & parameters; int, float, bool, string; list<T> and
ordered map<K,V>, nested freely; ownership checks; a multi-threaded
JSON HTTP server (serve) with query/form/JSON-body helpers; SQLite (db_*) where SQL injection does not compile;
modules (import/export, module::fn()); Git packages (pin get, pin.lock with sha256).
Not yet: inheritance/interfaces, null, finally, closures, default parameter values, PostgreSQL.
By design: no TLS — a proxy does https in both directions (design/tls.md).

Read the AI guide before writing Pin (raw URL below): it is the complete language on one page. The PHP habits
that do not compile, most common first:
- no null / ?T: use -1, "", an empty list or a bool
- a map holds ONE value type: for JSON objects with mixed values declare a class and json_encode(new Obj(...))
- empty containers need a type: list<int> $xs = []; map<string,int> $m = [];
- functions that can fail are declared `: T throws`; every call needs `try f()` or `try f() catch ($e) { ...; value; }`
- lists, maps and objects MOVE on `=` (copy() for two); parameters are read-only (`T &$x` and `f(&$x)` to change)
- request input: query_param($path, "k"), form_param($body, "k"), json_string/json_int($body, "k"); nested JSON:
  json_raw($json, "k"), json_len($arr), json_at($arr, $i)
- no closures, array_map, sprintf, switch: write the loop, join strings with . or "$var", use if/elseif
- sleep_ms(1000), not sleep(1); parallel work: $t = go f(); ... try await $t;
- loop: pin check --json file.pn -> fix the reported line -> repeat

- [AI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pin-language/docs/HEAD/ai-guide.md): the complete language on one page — rules, idioms, PHP → Pin table, error → fix table
- [Built-in reference](https://github.com/pin-language/docs/blob/HEAD/reference/README.md): every function with a tested example
- [Learn Pin](https://github.com/pin-language/docs/blob/HEAD/learn/README.md): 14 short chapters for people
- [Language guide](https://github.com/pin-language/docs/blob/HEAD/language.md): the same language explained for people
- [Examples](examples/): runnable programs, including JSON APIs with and without SQLite
- Tooling: `pin check --json FILE.pn` (one JSON error per line), `pin FILE.pn` (compile and run), `pin build FILE.pn -o OUT`, `pin get HOST/OWNER/REPO@VERSION`
